title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.
body:
## Revolutionizing Dating Apps with AI Matchmaking
A new generation of dating apps is emerging, catering to the needs of Gen Z users who are disillusioned with traditional swipe-based platforms. Ditto, a novel dating initiative, is leveraging AI technology to connect people in a more meaningful way. By ditching the swiping mechanism, Ditto aims to provide a more genuine and effortless dating experience for its users.

## How Ditto Works
The Ditto algorithm uses a unique approach to match users, focusing on the underlying characteristics and personality traits that define an individual's interests and hobbies. Rather than relying on surface-level similarities, the AI chatbot delves deeper to identify commonalities that can spark chemistry between two people. Users engage with Ditto through a text-based onboarding process, providing information about their personality, interests, and dating preferences. This data is then used to facilitate matches every Wednesday at 7 p.m., complete with a suggested time, location, and date.

## Impact on Developers and Researchers
Ditto's innovative approach to matchmaking has significant implications for the dating app industry and the broader field of AI research. By demonstrating the potential of AI-driven matchmaking, Ditto is paving the way for more sophisticated and effective dating platforms. Developers and researchers can draw inspiration from Ditto's use of AI to analyze complex human behaviors and preferences, applying these insights to other areas of social interaction and relationship-building. As the dating landscape continues to evolve, Ditto's pioneering work is likely to influence the development of more personalized and engaging social experiences.
